principles: Transparent pre-enrolment disclosure across all course pricing and admissions entry points.
Zero hidden cancellation terms; all exclusions and timing cut-offs clearly published.
Promotional, discounted and scholarship restrictions explicitly disclosed.
Non-binding information requests (demos, counselling) kept free of legal agreement friction.
Strict alignment between frontend disclosures and official published legal policy text.

summary.short: Review our Refund & Cancellation Policy before enrolment. Cancellations 7+ days prior to batch start qualify for 100% tuition refund (minus nominal administrative fee capped at ₹1,000 or 10%). A 48-hour cooling-off period applies if enrolling within 7 days. Fees are non-refundable once classes commence, LMS is accessed, or for promotional enrollments.
summary.noticeText: Please review our course cancellation, refund eligibility, cooling-off conditions and non-refundable situations before proceeding with enrolment.
summary.modalAdvisory: Important: Prior to fee payment or seat confirmation, please review our official Refund & Cancellation Policy. Special promotional offers, batch commencement, or LMS activation affect refund eligibility.

section2_registrationDeposit.title: Registration & Seat Booking Fee
section2_registrationDeposit.statement: Non-refundable initial deposit (typically 10% to 15% or up to ₹1,000) collected to secure batch allocation and provision LMS access.

section3A_earlyCancellation.title: Requests ≥ 7 Days Prior to Batch Start
section3A_earlyCancellation.deduction: Nominal administrative registration fee, capped at ₹1,000 or 10% of total fee, whichever is lower.
section3A_earlyCancellation.condition: Written email submitted 7 calendar days or more before official batch launch date.

section3B_coolingOff.title: Requests Within 7 Days of Batch Start (Cooling-Off Period)
section3B_coolingOff.condition: First live class or classroom session must not have commenced.

section3C_emergencyTransfer.title: Personal Emergencies / Rescheduling
section3C_emergencyTransfer.validity: Transferable to any upcoming batch within 6 months prior to batch launch.

section4_nonRefundable.title: Non-Refundable Situations
conditions: Once batch commences or student attends 1 or more live/classroom lectures
Once LMS credentials or proprietary study materials have been activated/accessed
Absence from scheduled classes or voluntary withdrawal after batch launch
Suspension or termination due to student code of conduct violations
Discounted, promotional, or scholarship enrolments under Section 4
Personal change of mind or scheduling conflicts arising post-registration

section5_instituteCancellation.title: Institute Cancellation or Delay (> 14 Calendar Days)
section5_instituteCancellation.guarantee: 100% Full Refund of all fees paid (including registration deposit) without deductions, or free priority transfer to next cohort.
